_comment: HOMEPAGE HERO CONFIG — edit this file to change the 5 hero carousel titles. The build resolves each slug against the catalogue (title, type, year, genres, poster, trailer) so you only need slugs + optional taglines. Validation: the build warns if a slug is missing, has no verified trailer, or has no poster. Taglines are editorial and should stay true to the title's actual description.

hero.tagline: Childhood games with life-or-death stakes — desperate players risk everything for a fortune.
A gamer wakes up in an empty Tokyo where every game is a fight to stay alive.
A warrior and a boy cross a feudal wasteland where survival is a martial art.
The weakest hunter gains a mysterious System — and begins a rise nobody expected.
The classic vampire nightmare returns, shot like a gothic fever dream.
